FOLDER.NAME: MDM_PARTY
FOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Party golden record sync. Uses mplt_DQ_PARTY_STANDARDISE (see mapplets/).

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Nightly golden-record sync POLARIS PARTY -> MDM hub. Survivorship: most-recent-update wins EXCEPT email where longest-string wins (undocumented decision, 2020). Uses NINO exact + NAME_DOB fuzzy match to attach LEGACY_CUSTOMER_ID from APF banking customers. Match rate stuck at ~55% since 2024 audit; unmatched pairs accumulate in MDM_SUSPECT_QUEUE (currently 41k rows, unworked).
MAPPING.NAME: m_PARTY_MDM_SYNC

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Email DQ + normalisation - DQR-007 variant B: lowercases then full RFC-ish regex. The BTEQ variant checks only for '@'. The banking customer pipeline does no email validation at all.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_EMAIL_DQ

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: NINO masking for downstream marts (ports logic of legacy GSS Pseudossn job). NOTE the SAS fraud pipeline reads PARTY.NINO raw - masking here protects only the Informatica-fed marts.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_NINO_MASK

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF(ISNULL(in_NINO) OR LENGTH(in_NINO) < 9, NULL, SUBSTR(in_NINO,1,2) || '*****' || SUBSTR(in_NINO,8,2))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_NINO_MASKED

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Fuzzy NAME_DOB match to APF banking CUSTOMERS where NINO match fails. Soundex surname + exact DOB. DOB in PARTY is DD/MM/YYYY *text*, DOB in CUSTOMERS is ISO date - conversion inline.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_XMATCH_APF

MAPPLET.DESCRIPTION: Reusable party standardisation: name case, phone normalisation, postcode repair+validate (DQR-014 variant A - see also BTEQ variant in 04_stg_policy_360 and SAS variant in check_uk_postcode.sas; three engines, three answers). Consumed by wf_PARTY_MDM_SYNC and wf_POLICY_MASTER_DAILY. The GSS payroll estate has its OWN address standardiser (see legacy_shared_services) - a fourth variant, US-format, applied to UK addresses since a 2018 copy-paste.
MAPPLET.NAME: mplt_DQ_PARTY_STANDARDISE

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: UK mobile normalisation to 07xxxxxxxxx; +44 prefix folded.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_PHONE_STD

WORKFLOW.DESCRIPTION: Nightly 01:30. Control-M ALB-MDM-0003. Must finish before wf_POLICY_MASTER_DAILY (03:15) - no explicit dependency defined, relies on runtime luck.
WORKFLOW.NAME: wf_PARTY_MDM_SYNC
